[SWS_TcpIp_00169] ⌈The TcpIp IP-layer shall map received IP datagrams to an entry
in the local address table (TcpIpAddrId).
The local address table mapping is successfully if ALL of the following conditions are
fulfilled:
1. The receiving interface matches the interface assigned to the local address table
entry (EthIfCtrl).
2. The destination IP address contained in the IP header matches the currently
assigned IP address of the local address table entry.
